items.note: States that it is a B2B note-taking app.
Says the readers are engineering and design leads, for a kickoff.
Lists creating a workspace, inviting members by email and shared notes as v1 scope.
Says there are only two roles: admin and member.
Lists billing changes, SSO and guest access as out of scope.
Gives the metric as 20% of paid accounts creating a workspace within 60 days, to be used as given.
Asks for about 2 pages, which it says twice.
Keeps migration of existing shared notes as an open question and says not to resolve it.

invented: The prompt says the leads will use the PRD to decide 'whether' to start work on team workspaces. The person only said the PRD is for a kickoff, which suggests the work is already going ahead, not that it is still a go/no-go decision.
